verses.text: Ha t'a chonhab' Belén, t'a yol yik Judea, hata' ix alji Jesús. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winhaj Herodes ayoch reyal t'a Judea. Ay juntzanh heb' winh winak skuchan mago schuman yet' k'e'en k'anal. Ayik toxo ix alji Jesús, ix kot heb' winh b'aj sja k'u. Ix ja heb' winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ix sk'anb'anek' heb' winh: --¿B'aj ay jun unin toto ix alji, jun ol och he reyalok a ex israel ex tik? Ha b'aj sja k'u, hata' ix kil sk'eul jun k'e'en k'anal. Ha k'e'en sch'oxani to ix alji. Yuj chi' onh koti, yik skak'em ko b'a t'ay, xchi heb' winh.
Haxo ix yab'an spekal jun chi' winhaj rey Herodes, ix te somchaj spensar winh. Yet' jantak heb' ay t'a Jerusalén chi', ix te somchajk'e heb' yet' winh.
Ix yawtankot masanil heb' winh sat sacerdote winh yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh: --¿B'ajtil ol aljok winh Cristo? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha t'a chonhab' Belén, t'a yol yik Judá, hata' ol aljok winh. Yujto ay jun schekab' Dios tz'ib'annakkan icha tik:

Ha jun chonhab' Belén, t'a yol yik Judea, yunenhej t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Palta ek'al yopisio t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab' chi'. Yujto hata' ol aljok jun winh yajal, Ha ol ilan in chonhab' Israel, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, xchi heb' winh.
Haxo winhaj Herodes chi' ix chekan awtajkot heb' winh mago chi'. Elk'altak ix sk'anb'ej winh yab' t'a heb' winh, b'ak'nhitax ix sch'ox sb'a jun k'anal chi' t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi yab'an winh, ix chekjib'at heb' winh yuj winh t'a chonhab' Belén. Ayik manto b'at heb' winh, ix stz'akan yal winh icha tik: --Ixikek t'a Belén chi'. Cham wal he k'anb'an eyab'i b'ajtil ayek' jun unin chi'. Slajwi schax chi' eyu'uj, tzul eyalan t'ayin, yik ol in b'at wak'paxem in b'a t'ay, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh. Haxo jun k'anal syil heb' winh b'aj sjawi k'u chi', b'ab'el sb'at yuj heb' winh, masanto ix k'och t'a stojolal yib'anh b'aj ay jun unin chi'. Hata' ix och wa'an.
Haxo ix yilanxi jun k'anal chi' heb' winh, ix te tzalaj heb' winh.

Ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun pat chi'. Ix yilan jun unin chi' heb' winh yet' snun, haton ix María. Ix em kuman heb' winh t'ay. Ix yak'anem sb'a heb' winh t'ay. Ixlajwi chi', ix sjakan juntzanh skaxa heb' winh b'aj ayem juntzanh silab'. Ix sian oro heb' winh t'a jun unin chi'. Ix sian juntzanh te suk'uk'i sjab' heb' winh, snhusji yet' juntzanhxo yal te suk'uk'i sjab' skuchan mirra.
Haxo ix alji t'a heb' winh t'a swayich, to maxtzak ek' heb' winh yal t'a winhaj Herodes chi'. Yuj chi' ch'okxo b'e b'aj ix pax heb' winh t'a schonhab'.

Ixlajwi spax heb' winh mago chi', ay jun yángel Dios Kajal ix ch'ox sb'a t'a winhaj José chi' t'a swayich, ix yalani: --K'e'anh wa'an. Ik'b'at winh unin tik het'ok yet' snun. Elanhek t'a elanhchamel. Tzex b'at t'a Egipto. Tzex kannhej ta', masanto ol walxi t'ayach, yujto a winhaj Herodes ol chekan sayjokek' jun unin tik, yujto snib'ej winh ol yak' miljokchamok, xchi jun ángel chi'.
Yuj chi', ix k'e wa'an winhaj José chi'. Ix yik'anb'at jun unin chi' winh yet' ix María t'ak'walil. Ix b'at heb' t'a Egipto.
Hata' ix aj heb' masanto ix cham winhaj Herodes chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan Dios Kajal a ix lolon t'a sti' jun schekab'. Xchi icha tik: Ha t'a Egipto ix wawtej paxta Wuninal, xchi.

Haxo ix yilan winhaj Herodes chi' to majxo ek' heb' winh mago chi' yal t'a winh, ix sna'anel winh to tonhej ix ak'ji musansatil winh yuj heb' winh. Yuj chi', ix te kot yowal winh. Ix schekan miljokcham jantaknhej heb' winak unin winh ay t'a chonhab' Belén yet' heb' ay t'a slak'anil jun chonhab' chi'. Ix laj cham heb' schab'il ab'il yet' heb' manto tz'akwi chab' ab'il. Yujto icha chi' stiempo'al ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a heb' winh mago chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Jeremías. Xchi icha tik:

Ix ab'chaj jun aw t'a chonhab' Ramá. Ay jun niwan ok'el yet' jun niwan kusk'olal. Ha ix Raquel, ix ok' ix yuj heb' yune'. Malaj snib'ej ix tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'o'ol, yujto manhxalaj heb' yune' ix, xchi.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Herodes chi', ix sch'oxan sb'a jun yángel Dios Kajal t'a winhaj José chi' t'a swayich, ayik ayek' winh t'a Egipto. Ix yalan t'a winh:
--K'e'anh wa'an. Ik'b'at winh unin tik yet' snun. Paxanhek t'a he chonhab', yujto a heb' winh snib'ej smilancham jun unin tik, chamnakxo heb' winh, xchi jun ángel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e wa'an winhaj José chi'. Ix yik'ankot jun unin chi' winh yet' ix snun t'a yol yik Israel chi'.

Palta ix yab'an winhaj José chi' to a jun winh yuninal winhaj Herodes skuchan Arquelao aykanoch sk'exulok winh smam chi' yak'an mandar t'a Judea chi'. Yuj chi', ix xiw winh sk'och kajan ta'. Ix yalan Dios t'a winh t'a swayich tas sk'ulej. Yuj chi' ix b'atkan heb' t'a yol yik Galilea.

Ayik ix k'och heb' ta', ix kajnaj heb' t'a chonhab' Nazaret. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'. Tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb', chajtil to ol yal heb' anima to aj Nazaret Jesús.
